modal.title: Best Delegate ×2 — Masters' Summit MUN
modal.desc: Back-to-back Best Delegate at Masters' Summit MUN — first in UNCSW representing Brazil (June 2024), then again in August 2025. Two different agendas, the same method: deep committee research, evidence-first argumentation and coalition-building that holds up over long sessions. Came with a ₹15,000 cash prize.

modal.title: Special Mention — MU20 Opportunity Summit 2024
modal.desc: Special Mention — the third-highest delegate award — in the AIPPM committee at the MU20 Opportunity Summit 2024 (19–21 October, Indore), billed as Asia's biggest high-school career conference. Contemporary Indian policy and economics, high-pressure committee dynamics, and arguments that had to survive scrutiny. Two months earlier: High Commendation — the second-highest award — representing Sweden in ECOSOC at the Sahodaya Model United Nations 2024.

modal.title: Rapid Chess — Strategy Under the Clock
modal.desc: 2nd place at the U-19 State Level Rapid Chess championship (2025) and 10th in Under-18 Boys at the UICC Trophy rapid tournament (December 2024). Chess is where the analytical habit was built — probabilistic thinking, pattern recognition and calm decisions under time pressure.

modal.title: Transportation Research Project
modal.desc: Conducted an independent research project on Transportation for the Sahodaya Senior Balvigyan (Commerce) inter-school competition (Indore Sahodaya Schools Complex, January 2024) — primary and secondary data collection, identifying patterns in transportation economics and urban mobility, structuring findings into a coherent analytical narrative, and presenting conclusions to a judging panel. Won Best Research & Project across competing schools.
